videos.title_en: Building a Miniature Treehouse with Tweezers
videos.prompt: A hyper-realistic cinematic miniature construction scene deep inside a misty tropical rainforest. Tiny workers use tweezers, hammers, ropes and pulleys to build a luxurious treehouse between enormous moss-covered trees. Extreme macro shots of hands assembling wooden beams and installing tiny glass windows, with rain droplets and wet leaves. End with a wide reveal of the completed treehouse glowing warmly above the canopy, surrounded by mist and a distant waterfall. Photorealistic miniature diorama, shallow depth of field, no text.
videos.prompt_source: exact prompt from Gemini chat history (private chat)
videos.notes: Tiny hard-hat workers and a pair of tweezers build a wooden treehouse on a mossy tree trunk, rainforest leaves with droplets.

videos.title_en: Baby Fox Attempting Its First Flight
videos.prompt: Generate a video: Create a seamless, whimsical cinematic animation of an adorable chubby baby fox with fluffy pastel-blue fur and tiny feathered wings attempting its first flight on the edge of a magnificent floating sky island. Begin with a low-angle shot as the fox stands nervously near the precipice, surrounded by enormous fluffy white clouds glowing in warm golden-hour sunlight. A gentle breeze ruffles its soft fur, bushy tail, and tiny wings. The fox squeezes its eyes shut and flaps its little wings frantically. To its amazement, it rises just two inches above the ground. It opens its enormous eyes, looks down in disbelief, and realizes it is actually flying. Its nervous expression instantly transforms into pure happiness as it performs a delightful mid-air wiggle. The camera slowly orbits the fox with dynamic parallax, capturing every adorable expression and movement. Use cinematic backlighting, soft amber highlights, realistic fluffy fur, delicate feather details, expressive facial animation, dreamy volumetric clouds, and polished 3D animated-film quality. Keep the baby fox as the only main character. Preserve its pastel-blue fur and tiny wings throughout. Make the scene magical, emotionally engaging, irresistibly cute, and visually memorable.
